editorial_ideas.idea: Growing MSME credit, with outstanding balances distinguished from new investment.
Track public capital spending actually booked month by month alongside the annual budget.
District-level credit access reveals variation hidden by state averages.
Eight-year income and economic-size series, with estimate vintages kept visible.

idea.title: More women are connected to banking and the internet
idea.qualification: Age 15–49, NFHS survey estimates; internet measure is ever-use. Bank access does not prove income growth.

idea.title: Health financing coverage reaches more households
idea.qualification: At least one household member insured/covered; no claim that every member or all costs are covered.

idea.title: The education system behind Odisha’s next generation
idea.qualification: Administrative scale, academic 2024–25, not a learning-quality ranking.

idea.title: A major historical reduction in multidimensional deprivation
idea.qualification: NFHS-era comparison; no implication these are present-day poverty rates.

idea.title: Nutrition is a mixed story that needs precise wording
idea.qualification: Stunting reduction cannot be marketed as universal improvement in child nutrition.

idea.title: A living lagoon, measured in more than a million birds
idea.angle: Use 11.32 lakh birds counted in the 2026 estimation as an invitation to learn about habitat and guides; no sighting guarantee.

idea.title: The coastal state is also an inland fish producer
idea.angle: A simple split explains where the 11.92-lakh-tonne annual output comes from; freshwater/brackish definitions need a second chart.

idea.title: Millets connect the landscape to the plate
idea.angle: Show cultivation expansion beside a credited local cook or grower; area expansion is not evidence of nutrition outcomes.

idea.title: Resilience has a physical footprint
idea.angle: Map delivered project works with completion dates, then add present-day local reporting.

idea.title: More crops from the same agricultural landscape
idea.angle: Explain seasonal cropping with one illustration; keep the utilisation gap visible.

idea.idea: Bhubaneswar crossed five million annual passenger movements.
idea.qualification: FY2025–26 airport movements, not unique tourists.
idea.visual: Two bars, 48.39 lakh and 51.31 lakh, with exact figures in evidence.

idea.idea: A tourism foundation of more than one lakh hotel beds.
idea.qualification: Department recorded 1,06,254 hotel beds across 2,480 establishments in 2024; current operation not checked.
idea.visual: One headline number and district drill-down; do not infer occupancy or visitor satisfaction.

idea.idea: More than a lakh livelihoods behind the loom.
idea.qualification: Fourth Handloom Census 2019–20; a historical combined census count, not current total.
idea.visual: Weavers and allied workers shown as two labelled groups with credited contemporary maker profiles.

idea.idea: Paradip handled 15.65 crore tonnes of cargo in a year.
idea.calculation: 156.45 million tonnes = 15.645 crore tonnes; annual growth = 4.0157%.
idea.qualification: FY2025–26; #2 major port per current authority page, not timeless #1; cargo is not Odisha exports.
idea.visual: Annual throughput comparison; port scope visible.

idea.qualification: Identified tourist-centre list as of April 2026; each place still needs practical visitor checks.
idea.visual: Browse by district, interest and season rather than treating the count as visitor readiness.

idea.title: Connections have expanded; reliable service is the next measure
idea.angle: Show explicit dated coverage and a district example; add quality and regularity once verified.

idea.title: Measure cleaner cities with consistent annual evidence
idea.angle: Show mixed city trends together; improvements in one city are not statewide clean-air evidence.

idea.title: The systems behind a welcoming city
idea.angle: Explain the infrastructure in one graphic while keeping capacity, operation and remaining waste distinct.

idea.qualification: Ordinary applications FY2023–24 to FY2024–25, not grants. Applicant concentration and revisions require follow-up.

idea.idea: Women have a formal leadership presence in half of recognised startups.
idea.qualification: 1,796 of 3,589 DPIIT-recognised entities have at least one woman director/partner at 31 December 2025; do not call this half women-founded.
idea.visual: Half-circle or 100-dot graphic, exact definition visible.
